curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with title, registration and insurance before driving, then who may process the transaction, leased and financed vehicles, the sixty-day newcomer deadline, the BA-forty-nine application, proof of ownership, sales tax, and registration length.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the owner versus the leasing company and for four-year versus one-year registrations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what must happen before a vehicle is driven and on registration paperwork.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how many plates each vehicle gets, mounting height, rear plate lighting, covers, valid plates, lost or stolen plates, counterfeit plates, and when plates are turned in or transferred.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per plate rule; contrast cards for mounting height versus lighting distance and for surrender versus transfer.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on plate placement, lighting and surrender.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the two-year passenger inspection, the five-year new car dealer sticker, the yearly commercial inspection, the one-year commercial sticker, and the diesel passenger rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per schedule; contrast cards for two years versus every year and five-year versus one-year stickers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps inspection intervals and sticker lengths.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the fourteen-day inspection rule for a new resident's older vehicle, the exemption for newer vehicles, what to bring, and where inspections happen, including specialty sites.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for older versus newer vehicles of a new resident.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on new resident inspection timing and inspection locations.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover mandatory liability insurance, the insurance ID card and where it must be shown, penalties for driving uninsured, coverage choices, and insurance fraud penalties and reporting.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for uninsured driving penalties versus fraud penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on insurance requirements, the ID card and fraud.
